title: Full rational tensor-Hom identifications and finite-scalar evaluation
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, a separated finite-type D.k-scheme X, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and a Q_l-algebra embedding i:E→L. For any coherent integral dualizing data wE,wL and rational Verdier data A,B [def-sf-rational-verdier-data], there exist full Hom identifications hE,hL [def-sf-rational-verdier-identifications] with HomScalarCompatibility for the recorded rational Hom and tensor scalar comparisons. Thus both tensor-Hom adjunctions have the prescribed integral evaluation, both identify the given dualities with internal Hom into omega, and their evaluations commute with i.

proof.text: Integral internal Hom of constructible inputs is constructible. Convert intrinsic completeness to legacy completeness, apply integral_constructible_internalHom, and convert completeness back. Since raw rational objects are the same integral objects, this supplies every permitted rational Hom pair.
Apply the normalized rational adjunction construction independently to E and L, using the ordinary tensor presentation and completion already present in A and B.

With the second Hom input fixed to omega, use the recorded internal-Hom object equation and A.objects to identify its objects with A.dual. Bilinearity makes this fixed-second-input functor additive. The pure-map equation is identical to A.pure. Induction on raw tensor morphisms and functor extensionality prove equality of functors. The same argument applies to B. Use these equalities as the duality isomorphisms.

At each unchanged integral object, the normalized counit equation and A.evaluation_integral identify the evaluations. The tensor image of the equality-isomorphism component is heterogeneous transport of the same counit; equality induction removes it. This completes all fields of the HomIdentification records for E and L.
Apply the finite-scalar evaluation square to the two constructed full Hom identifications and assemble the required existential witnesses.

proof_origin.place: V4: direct restriction and scalar localization using the completion data already supplied; duality comparison proved by object/pure-map extensionality. Only the finite-scalar evaluation square remains a split obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalHom_identifications
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X E wE)
    (B : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X L wL) :
    ∃ (hE : HomIdentification l E X D hl wE A)
      (hL : HomIdentification l L X D hl wL B),
      HomScalarCompatibility l E X D hl L ι wE wL A B hE hL
